[1/3] Plan: habit evidence plus slip-tolerant recovery nudge

impact_assessment.why: Habit strength improves with intervention (SMD 0.69, 39685110) but takes ~2 months; single misses do not reset formation (Lally 2009); habit correlates with frequency at r=0.46 (21626256). The app punishes nothing but also says nothing after a slip
impact_assessment.benefits: a missed day gets a warm, evidence-true response instead of silence; habit horizon (~2 months) sets honest expectations
impact_assessment.risks: contract: display-only derivation from history; dependency: none new; concurrency: n/a; state: no new keys
impact_assessment.mitigation: pure date logic over stored sessions; copy gain-framed and lint-checked; no streak penalty anywhere

[1/3] Plan: per-mechanic focus sessions plus weakest-link suggestion

impact_assessment.why: Spacing and testing rows (16719566, 25150680) plus Adesope/Latimier moderators support spaced retrieval of the weakest material with delayed retest; the app can only train all four mechanics at once
impact_assessment.benefits: users re-test exactly what wobbles, spaced by days; autonomy preserved via explicit choice
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive config path and card; dependency: none new; concurrency: n/a; state: focus is a transient start option, not stored
impact_assessment.mitigation: default session unchanged; focus reuses blocks/results/history/export untouched; copy gain-framed and lint-checked

[1/2] Plan: optional temptation-bundling pairing in the when-where plan

impact_assessment.why: Pairing training with an existing indulgence lifted gym visits 51% enforced and ~10-14% self-set; the intention form has when/where but no pairing cue
impact_assessment.benefits: self-set bundling rule at zero coercion; pairs with an existing routine the user already enjoys
impact_assessment.mitigation: optional third field, same length cap; tolerant loader keeps old plans valid; no export change; lint-checked copy
